plan.subject: Understand the foundational concepts of Machine Learning and its real-world applications.
plan.objective: Understand the foundational concepts of Machine Learning and its real-world applications.

blocks.title: What is Machine Learning?
blocks.teachingObjective: This is the core definition that sets the foundation for understanding all subsequent concepts.
examples: Machine Learning is the study of computer algorithms that improve automatically through experience.

blocks.title: Mathematical Foundations
blocks.teachingObjective: These mathematical tools are essential for understanding how Machine Learning algorithms work.
examples: Probability theory, linear algebra, and calculus are used to model and optimize ML algorithms.

blocks.title: Real-World Applications of ML
blocks.teachingObjective: Understanding real-world applications helps students grasp the relevance and impact of ML.
examples: Smart assistants and advertising are examples of how ML is applied in everyday life.

blocks.title: Big Picture of ML
blocks.teachingObjective: This concept provides a high-level view of how ML works and what it aims to achieve.
examples: Taking picking fruits as an example to illustrate the ML process.
